0.original: Maru has a mitey problem for you.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Survey the area from the designated location and defeat the starmites that appear.

48.original: You know what a starmite is, right? Those hulkin' bugs? Well, they're on my blacklist now!

49.original: I got chased by one the other day over by the old Hamsa Hatchery. My hippo startled so badly, I thought for sure I was goin' overboard...

50.original: The starmites themselves ain't as dangerous as the fear they instill in our poor hippos, but a hazard's a hazard. Think you could lend us your hand of judgment an' cull the buggers?

51.original: You remember those starmites you squashed? Well...they're bein' avenged.

52.original: It's hard to tell what's more shaken─our sweet hippos' hearts or our cargo. Either way, all that's waitin' for us on those roads is bugs an' sorrow...

53.original: You've gotta help us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Head back over to the Perfumed Rise an' reunite those starmites with their maker...

54.original: You're a savior, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We can ride easy now, knowin' there are fewer starmites on the roads...

55.original: Bein' chased is bad enough, but if we were to hit one at any speed, the cart would be wrecked an' the darlin' hippo injured─if not worse.

56.original: Safe ridin's no trivial thing, so I might ask for your help smashin' starmites again sometime. Thanks for always lookin' out for us.
